explainer_content.short_definition: Mainstream 1990s country radio: huge choruses, visible country identity, and new-traditionalist roots under arena lights.
explainer_content.history_capsule: The 1990s country boom turned Nashville stars into stadium and CD-era giants while keeping traditional country markers audible for mass audiences.
explainer_content.why_it_mattered: It created a modern country mainstream that shaped radio expectations for decades.
explainer_content.what_made_it_distinct: It can sound polished and enormous while still advertising country identity through vocal, fiddle, steel, and image.
